name: std/base
description: The library that needs no host: streams and number conversion, bit sets and bit streams, events and channels, locks and pipes, the plugin registry.
residual: The modules under `graphical` belong to this package but cannot travel in the headless SDK: their own import closure reaches the window system. The list is checked against the import graph by docker/gen-headless-core.sh, so it cannot go quietly out of date.

Members were selected as high-fan-in AND low-fan-out (true foundation). High-fan-in HUBS were deliberately excluded because they also fan out into higher tiers and belong there, not in base: Configuration/Localization (pull XML -> std/web), Codecs (pull Raster -> std/gfx, SoundDevices), Repositories/Models (pull XML + WMEvents -> std/web + std/gui), Types (pull Texts -> std/text).
Candidate additions pending confirmation they stay runtime-only: none outstanding in this batch.

Channels is a parametric module: it is instantiated in an import (Channels(Event)) and therefore must be in the library as a symbol file before anything can instantiate it. A module beside the program cannot be.
Base64 entered 2026-08-24: Streams and nothing else, which is what this package is for. It was named by no package at all.
BitStreams and StreamUtilities (Hunziker) entered 2026-08-24: reading and writing below the byte, and stream helpers -- Streams and nothing else, which is what this package is for.

ReleaseThreadPool (staubesv, a pool with job dependencies) and TFStringPool entered 2026-08-24. Both are library over Strings and locks despite their names, which is why they are here and not with the release tooling or the TF tools.

Re-homed 2026-08-27 by the shared-type rule (docs/STDLIB.md): a package holds what other packages talk to each other through. See that file for what moved where and why. Out: the string family and Texts to std/text, Dates to std/time, Base64 and CRC to std/encoding, Options to std/system (it is about the host's command line), TFClasses to std/data. Options and TFClasses had to leave: they import Strings, so keeping them here would make base and text a cross-package cycle.
Out on 2026-08-27: FP1616, Inputs and WMEvents to lib/gui -- they are the window manager's tail, and this package is the one that needs no host. Plugins stays: Network imports it.
